notes.title: Updated Drafting Physics for Official Races
notes.content:
Slightly decreased opponent aggression.

 Significantly decreased pull back strength to promote more side by side racing.

notes.title: DRAFTYCAR v1.74
notes.content: Generated some performance enhancements by removing dynamic shadows from objects that didn't need to cast them.

notes.title: v1.73 Minor Update
notes.content:
The race distance percentages should be more accurate now.
 
 Reduced drag, so pulling out from behind other cars wont slow down a car as quickly.

notes.title: v1.72 Update
notes.content:
New drafting parameters for official sessions.
 Top down view can now be used in official sessions by hitting V on the keyboard or the left special button on your gamepad.

notes.title: V 1.70
notes.content:
Thank you for your support! 


 Forest Run (night) is getting a temporary break from the category 5 hurricane. 
 The top lane is more competitive and less likely to lose momentum.


*We're also working on a control to turn music on and off for streamers.

notes.title: v 1.65
notes.content: Fixed a paint scheme glitch that would cause the default car to populate multiple times.
